text: hey inside of the world editor in @cart/hmsc-int/ you can place a prop ontop of other props, but inside of the @cart/editor/ it doesnt seem to be the same. for example i have a table i am trying to place another item on, i can use the scroll wheel to lift the item but it always sits higher than nthe table top where before it would find the table top and place on it
resolution: Ported hmsc-int's stacking snap rule into the editor's world viewport: placing a prop now raycasts the placed pieces (host catalog raycast + authored-mesh slab test) along the cursor ray, and a top-face hit nearer than the ground becomes the placement base — so a lamp lands exactly ON the table top where the ray touched it, no wheel fiddling. The scroll-wheel lift (req_2751) still works and now rides above the support surface instead of the terrain, so lift 0 = flush on the table. Root cause: resolveSnap only ever asked __compiled_world_ground_hit (painted terrain), so placed pieces were invisible to the placement ray. Changed cart/editor/world/pieces.ts (resolvePlacement supportY param), WorldViewport.tsx (supportUnder probe wired into resolveSnap — ghost, hover readout, and click all share it), pieces.test.ts (+1 test, 11/11 green).
